summary: Client: telecommunications provider in Japan. Moved to HCLTech with HPE's Communications Technology Group on its acquisition; same client and team.
responsibilities: Built a monthly Python batch job that cross-references MySQL billing data with LDAP subscriber records to export a CSV of unpaid manual-billing customers whose numbers were ported out, for forced cancellation, with a lock file against overlapping runs, a check against regenerating the same day's list, and unit tests.
Maintained and extended the existing billing reconciliation system through multiple production bug-fix releases.

Built, from a requirements document, a Perl toolkit for bulk LDAP password maintenance, such as mass resets and migrating stored passwords to bcrypt: LDIF generation and rollback templates to undo the changes if a deployment is reverted (rollback tested on a test server). Used in production.
Worked on a Perl batch job that detects mail accounts abused for spam or mass mailing through SMTP-Auth and restricts their SMTP access.

Extended a Python spam-report email service from a single discard-only report into a configurable dual-format reporter (legacy discard-only, or a combined report with separate quarantined and discarded sections, each with its own threshold and overflow message), with new templates, INI configuration and a large unit-test suite.
Primary engineer for the team's Perl projects; guide teammates by explaining each project and its tasks, and write documentation notes so they can carry on in my absence.
Take each project from a client requirements document to working code independently, clarifying open questions with the project manager.
Manually test each project's flows against expected outcomes and document the findings in test reports using the team's template (HPE and HCLTech projects).

summary: Communications Technology Group. Client: telecommunications provider in Japan.
responsibilities: Built, from requirement documents, the front end of a new self-service webmail settings portal (Thymeleaf, HTML, CSS, JavaScript): account overview, password change, retention periods, virus and junk mail controls, and bulk mail deletion.
Connected each page to the backend APIs, implemented client-side form validation, and displayed the backend's rejection messages.
Fixed layout and error-handling bugs in an Angular 8 operations portal (PrimeNG, Bootstrap, SCSS).
Implemented the user-move and recovery logic in a Perl mail account migration tool, adapting to changing client requirements. Carried through to production after the move to HCLTech.
Customised an existing enterprise portal product for a major Malaysian telecommunications provider to meet the client's requirements, working from user stories.
Built the new pages the client requested in Angular: admin, listing and custom package pages, plus a login integration page.
Set up Azure AD login for the application, serving two user roles (account managers and dealers).
Added, updated and removed code in an Express (Node.js) layer that sits between external APIs and the product and reshapes the data to fit the product.
Set up the application in the environment used by the performance testing team.
Fixed vulnerabilities reported by the security team's testing, and wrote reusable code to ease future maintenance.
Supported the client through UAT and PVT on site, and supported the production deployment, including out-of-hours.

Built the front end of two new modules from scratch for an HR software product, using Vue.js (Nuxt): Learning (course-based learning) and E-Travel (submission of travel documentation), in response to requests from multiple clients.
Fixed front-end bugs from a Jira backlog to keep the live system running.
Merged code and deployed releases and hotfixes from staging to live using Git.
Maintained an existing web application and built new React components for a redesigned interface.
Converted legacy jQuery code to React as part of the interface redesign.
Maintained the front end of an online travel platform that connects travellers with local travel experts to build customised itineraries, and built new reusable React components.
Used Linux and Docker for local development.
